case.summary: Customer C11923 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $131.30 (transaction ID 3583368) on card C11923-K2 on December 29, 2016. The purchase was made via device D009621, which was flagged as new to the account and substantially exceeded the cardholder's baseline transaction history of purchases under $48. Graph analysis established that device D009621 was used across four separate cards within a 48-hour window for near-identical amounts between $125 and $131, with a linked transaction on card C05595-K1 scoring 0.90 on the fraud model. The alert was confirmed as fraudulent under the card_not_present_new_device pattern, prompting immediate card blocking, monitoring of connected cards, and a regulatory filing.

sar.narrative: This report details unauthorized card-not-present activity identified on card account C11923-K2, held by customer C11923. On December 29, 2016, at 03:27:44 UTC, an unauthorized online transaction (ID 3583368) totaling $131.30 was processed on card C11923-K2. Customer C11923 contacted the institution shortly thereafter to deny authorizing the purchase. The transaction was conducted via device D009621, identified as an Android device with profile 'SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | unknown | chrome 66.0 for android | unknown', which was marked as newly introduced to the cardholder account. The purchase significantly diverged from the cardholder's prior spending baseline, which averaged $34.79 with a historical maximum of $47.02. Subsequent graph analysis revealed that device D009621 was utilized across four distinct card accounts within a 48-hour window for tightly clustered amounts ranging from $125.59 to $131.30. Specifically, device D009621 was connected to cards C05595-K1 (transaction 3582730), C03938-K1 (transaction 3582750), and C05678-K1 (transaction 3588413). Notably, transaction 3582730 on card C05595-K1 received an elevated model score of 0.90, carrying a 92.1% historical fraud rate. Card C11923-K2 also has a history of prior confirmed compromise under closed cases CC-3905 and CC-3206. The bank has blocked card C11923-K2 and initiated monitoring across all connected cards sharing device D009621. Total unauthorized exposure resulting from transaction 3583368 on the subject card is $131.30.

stop_reason: The investigation concluded under Policy Section 6 because the fraud probability reached a decisive 0.94, supported by multiple independent lines of evidence including direct customer denial, device status marked New, baseline deviation, and graph linkage to high-scoring multi-card fraud, ensuring further inquiries would not alter the outcome.
